purpose: Teach: 未遂/遭難/警鐘/脱税/伝染/装っ/書記官/触媒

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 未遂のセキュリティ事案、再発防止、進めろ。
lines.en: An attempted security breach—I want prevention measures in place. Move forward.
lines.style: Sharp, measured opening. Low register, absolute expectation. No softening. Eyes steady on Kenji. Cut-through tone, as if repeating something already understood.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外遭難リスク、出張者に周知しています。
lines.en: Yes. We've briefed all traveling staff on overseas distress protocols.
lines.style: Steady, respectful. Clipped but not rushed. A subordinate reporting back with confidence—not defensive, just clear. Small pause after the affirmative, then the detail.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 監査、警鐘を鳴らす可能性、避けたい。
lines.en: Audits. We need to make sure there's no red flag for them to raise.
lines.style: Flat, strategic. Not a question—a statement of intent. Slight emphasis on 'red flag.' The tone of someone managing downside risk, not optimizing upside.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。脱税疑惑、内部監査で確認済みです。
lines.en: Understood. Our internal audit has already cleared the tax-compliance concerns.
lines.style: Direct, professional. Leaning forward slightly with reassurance. Rapid delivery on the reassurance—no hesitation. Shows he's already solved this problem.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界内の伝染的な不祥事連鎖、当社で食い止めたい。
lines.en: This industry has a habit of one scandal bleeding into another. I want us to be the circuit breaker.
lines.style: Quieter than before, almost reflective. Slower. The weight of institutional responsibility in the voice. Not angry—determined. Like he's seen this pattern repeat.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 政治家を装った詐欺電話、社員に注意喚起しました。
lines.en: We've already alerted the team about the scam calls—people posing as government officials.
lines.style: Efficient, factual. No pride in it, but no apology either. Moving down the checklist. The pace picks up slightly—this is preventative work, it's done.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 書記官的な記録管理、徹底しろ。
lines.en: Understood. Documentation needs to be airtight. No exceptions.
lines.style: Firm, unambiguous. Hiroshi's tone lands hard on 'airtight.' No wiggle room in his voice. The kind of directive that expects immediate compliance and no follow-up questions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。組織改革の触媒となるよう、努めます。
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm committed to making sure we're not just compliant—we're ahead of it.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly elevated register. A promise more than just a report. Quiet sincerity underneath—he means this. Slight lift at the end, not a question but almost an offering.
